title: CS50’s Introduction to Programming with Python
prerequisites: No programming prerequisites; English lectures, shorts, problem sets.
assignment: Complete weeks 0–9 and your own final project. Pair with Think Python.
freshness: Current course site; syntax is durable. Free study; certification optional.

title: MIT Missing Semester 2026
prerequisites: Basic Python; English recordings and exercises.
assignment: Shell → environment → debugging → Git → shipping → code quality; revisit agentic coding after you can review code.
freshness: Verified 2026 syllabus and playlist linked by authors.

title: CS50x
prerequisites: Beginner-friendly but demanding; English lectures and assignments.
assignment: After Python, study algorithms, memory, data structures and web/SQL foundations. For stronger CS preparation complete the whole course.
freshness: Current OpenCourseWare; free study, optional certificate.

title: CS50 SQL
assignment: Querying → relating → designing → writing → viewing → optimizing → scaling; final project.
freshness: Current course site, exercises freely accessible.

title: 3Blue1Brown Essence of Linear Algebra
prerequisites: School algebra first; English visual video series.
assignment: Vectors → span/basis → transformations → multiplication → dot product → eigenvectors. Add written exercises from MML; videos alone do not establish fluency.
freshness: Foundational series; older recording remains suitable for these concepts.

title: Harvard Stat 110
prerequisites: Algebra and basic calculus; English lectures.
assignment: Counting/conditioning → Bayes → distributions → expectations → limit theorems; solve problems with the free probability book.
freshness: Author site links videos and a free second-edition textbook; not a 2026 API course.

title: Statistical Learning with Python (ISLP)
assignment: Read ISLP chapters in order and do Python labs. Use theory videos linked on the same official page. Covers models, resampling, regularization, trees and unsupervised learning.
freshness: Python edition 2023; stable ML foundations. Free author-linked videos/book; edX certificate unnecessary.

title: fast.ai Practical Deep Learning for Coders, part 1
prerequisites: Python and basic ML; English nine-lesson video course.
assignment: Complete nine lessons with your own dataset; then reimplement one training loop in raw PyTorch.
freshness: Recorded 2022. Strong project-first foundation; use current PyTorch docs for API fixes, not old package pins blindly.

title: Hugging Face LLM Course
prerequisites: Good Python and introductory DL, as the course states; English text with embedded videos.
assignment: Chapters 1–4 model basics, 5–8 data/tokenizers/tasks, 9 demos, 10–12 advanced training. Do labs; do not treat it as a pure YouTube playlist.
freshness: Living official course; verify package compatibility when running.

title: Full Stack LLM Bootcamp
prerequisites: Python, plus ML/backend experience; English recorded lectures.
assignment: Foundations → prompting → augmented models → UX → LLMOps. Build a small extraction service alongside it.
freshness: April 2023 recordings, explicitly dated by authors. Use for product/systems principles; update every SDK example through current docs.

title: LangChain RAG from Scratch
prerequisites: Python, model APIs and embeddings; English video series with notebooks.
assignment: Build a plain Python baseline first, then follow indexing/retrieval/query-transformation examples. Evaluate each addition.
freshness: Earlier tutorials; current LangChain/LlamaIndex docs are the API authority. Does not imply framework is required.

title: Hugging Face Agents Course
prerequisites: Python and LLM interfaces; text, videos and hands-on units.
assignment: Units 0–1 fundamentals; unit 2 smolagents/LangGraph/LlamaIndex; unit 3 use cases; unit 4 evaluated assignment.
freshness: Living official course; prioritize one framework implementation after learning the plain loop.

title: LangChain Academy — Introduction to LangGraph, Python
prerequisites: Python and agent basics; English video lessons.
assignment: Choose Introduction to LangGraph – Python in Build; focus state, persistence, streaming, review and recovery. One framework in depth.
freshness: Official course content free; account may be needed. Certification paid and optional.

title: Stanford CS336 Language Modeling from Scratch, 2026
prerequisites: Strong Python, PyTorch, calculus, probability, ML and systems; advanced English lectures.
assignment: Tokenizer/model/optimizer → training → systems → scaling → data → alignment. Do assignments at reduced compute scale and report deviations.
freshness: Current 2026 site explicitly links recordings. Some full assignments need substantial GPU compute; learning materials are free.

title: fast.ai Deep Learning Foundations to Stable Diffusion, part 2
prerequisites: Completed part 1 and strong Python; English videos.
assignment: Selected foundations and diffusion lessons; build one evaluated vision/audio/media project, not every modality simultaneously.
freshness: Older foundational course; follow current Diffusers and model-specific documentation for execution.

title: DataTalksClub MLOps Zoomcamp
prerequisites: Python, trained ML models, command line and Docker basics; English videos/materials.
assignment: Intro → tracking → orchestration → deployment → monitoring → practices → final project.
freshness: Repository actively maintained in 2026; recordings may be from earlier cohorts. Use current main syllabus, date your chosen cohort.

title: Hugging Face Deep RL Course
prerequisites: Probability, PyTorch and neural networks; mixed text/video/labs.
assignment: MDPs and value methods → policy gradients → PPO. Core ideas support post-training; environment specialization optional.
freshness: Official living course, update environment/library compatibility when running.
